sources.snippet: PlantNet-300K — Fine-grained plant species identification (LiteRT GPU) Identify 1081 plant species from a photo, fully on the LiteRT CompiledModel GPU. A PlantNet-300K (NeurIPS 2021) ResNet18 — the first fine-grained classifier in this zoo. ~16 ms/frame on a Pixel 8a.

sources.snippet: LiteRT.js is Google's high performance WebAI runtime, targeting production Web applications. It is a continuation of the LiteRT stack, ensuring multi-framework support and unifying our core runtime across all platforms.
